flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4173 then enter 100 in the Bill amount field
set Tip percent to 15
set Number of people to 3
check the Round up each share checkbox
click Calculate
verify the page says Each person pays $39.00

summary:
The calculation page encounters an internal error when it tries to format a value, so it stops before displaying the result.
Fix the calculation’s number formatting so all submitted values are converted to numbers before the result is displayed.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the outcome: it entered the requested bill amount and people count, used the displayed 15% tip, enabled rounding, and clicked Calculate. The submitted form visibly contained 100, 15, 3, and a checked rounding toggle; the failure immediately followed the Calculate action with a page error.
verdict.bug_title: Calculation crashes when valid bill inputs are submitted
verdict.suggestion: Fix the calculation’s number formatting so all submitted values are converted to numbers before the result is displayed.
